sentences.japanese: これはあなた宛ての手紙です。
sentences.english: This letter is addressed to you.

sentences.japanese: この手紙はあなた宛だ。
sentences.english: This letter is addressed to you.

sentences.japanese: あなたからご連絡がないので、１月１０日付であなた宛に出した電子メールは着いたのだろうかと思っています。
sentences.english: I wonder if you received my e-mail on January 10, since I have not heard anything from you yet.

sentences.japanese: 同一差出人から同一受取人に宛てて郵袋という、文字通り袋に印刷物を入れて郵送します。
sentences.english: A mailbag from a single sender addressed to one recipient, as the name suggests, is for delivering a bag of printed matter.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は、ジョン宛に手紙を書いた。
sentences.english: She addressed the letter to John.
